ios.desc:
Kwayet gives you real-time visibility into everything that's happening in your business, no matter where you are. You'll know who sold what, when, and where, and you'll be alerted to any suspicious activity. Plus, you'll be notified when your inventory is running low, so you can restock before it's too late.

Kwayet also makes it easy to track your profits and expenses, so you always know exactly how much money you're making and where it's coming from (cash, POS, bank transfers, etc.). You can see your profits for the day, week, month, etc. and what you have left in real-time.

Kwayet is perfect for all types of businesses, from shops and stores to supermarkets, hotels, farms, schools, restaurants, and offices. 

Please visit our website to learn more.
https://www.kwayet.app
